description: Cloud CRM platform for sales, service, marketing and custom apps, with APIs over standard and custom objects.
rate_limits: Daily per-org cap (base 100,000 + per-license allotment; Developer Edition 15,000/24h) and concurrent request limit (5 dev/trial, 25 production)

description: CRM platform for marketing, sales, service, content and operations, with a broad public API for CRM objects and more.
rate_limits: Marketplace-app installs: 110 requests / 10 s per installed account, plus daily limits; rate-limit headers returned

description: Sales-focused CRM and pipeline management platform for managing deals, contacts, leads and activities.
blocker: Public multi-tenant OAuth app needs Pipedrive Marketplace app approval for listing (private apps shareable by install link); sandbox-account request needed. API-token auth works immediately for single accounts.
rate_limits: Token-based daily budget (30,000 base tokens × plan multiplier × seats) plus per-user burst limit in rolling 2-second window

description: Attio is a customizable, AI-native CRM platform for managing pipeline, deals and accounts.
rate_limits: 100 req/s reads, 25 req/s writes; 429 with Retry-After

description: Open-source CRM (cloud or self-hosted) with schema-per-workspace REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth and an official MCP server.
rate_limits: 100 requests per minute; batch size 60 records per call

description: Podio (Progress/Citrix) is a customizable work-management and CRM platform with apps, workspaces, items, tasks and workflows.
rate_limits: 1,000 calls/hour general; 250/hour for rate-limited (resource-intensive) calls; per user per API key; 420 on exceed

description: Cloud CRM platform for sales, leads, contacts, deals and automation, with AI features.
rate_limits: Credit-based, 24h rolling: Free 5,000/day; Professional 50k+500/user; Enterprise 50k+1000/user. Concurrency 5-25 per org by edition; sub-concurrency 10 for heavy calls.

description: Close is a CRM for sales teams, with built-in calling, email, SMS, sequences and AI agents.
blocker: Trial-only for free access. Solo plan lacks high-volume API access. Third-party OAuth apps are private to the developer's own org until Close approves a public listing. OAuth scopes are limited to all.full_access and offline_access unless requested from support.
rate_limits: Per endpoint group, per API key; org limit is 3x a key's limit; 429 responses give rate_reset seconds

description: Copper is a CRM for Google Workspace users that manages leads, contacts, companies, opportunities, projects, tasks and activities.
blocker: Minor: OAuth needs manual app registration with Copper partners. API key auth is available self-serve. The official MCP is a Claude-only, read-only beta that is not yet live.
rate_limits: 180 requests/min (rolling window), bulk APIs 3 req/sec, 429 on exceed

description: Intapp DealCloud: CRM and deal management platform for private capital, investment banking and professional services firms.
blocker: No self-serve signup or developer sandbox. API credentials exist only inside a licensed DealCloud customer site, so building and testing needs a customer or partner tenant.
rate_limits: Per-endpoint: Data/Schema/Management 5 req/s, auth 300/min, Publications 1000/s; HTTP 429 on excess

description: Customer service and support platform: ticketing, help center, messaging, voice, live chat, sales CRM and AI agents.
blocker: The trial account is time-limited. OAuth global-client setup is needed for multi-tenant use. API tokens are being phased out. No official, documented vendor MCP server was found.
rate_limits: Per-minute by plan: Team 200, Professional 400, Enterprise 700 (High Volume add-on 2500); 429 + Retry-After

description: Customer messaging and support platform (inbox, help desk, Fin AI agent, help center) with a REST API for contacts, conversations, tickets and more.
rate_limits: 10,000 calls/min per private-app workspace (25,000/min per workspace across apps); 10-second windows; 429 on exceed

description: Cloud customer support helpdesk (ticketing, contacts, companies, knowledge base, SLAs) by Freshworks.
blocker: Free plan has no API access; testing needs a paid plan or 14-day trial. API-key only (no OAuth), and the key is per-subdomain, so the user must supply their domain. Rate limits are low on Growth.
rate_limits: Per-minute, per account, by plan: Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700; trial 50; lower per-endpoint caps (e.g. ticket create 50 on Growth)

description: Shared inbox and customer operations platform that unifies email, chat, SMS and social conversations with team collaboration and automation.
rate_limits: 50 req/min default (Starter), 100 Professional, 200 Enterprise; per company; extra burst guards on some endpoints

description: B2B support platform (Slack/Teams/email shared channels, ticketing, account management, AI agents) with a REST API for issues, accounts, contacts.
blocker: No self-serve signup or free sandbox. Working credentials need an existing Pylon customer workspace (sales-led trial or paid contract) and an Admin to create the token. Composio would need a partner or test account from Pylon.
rate_limits: Per-org, per-endpoint per minute; tiers of 30, 120, or 300 req/min; 429 rate_limited on excess

description: Cloud helpdesk platform (QualityUnit) with ticketing, live chat, call center and knowledge base for customer support.
blocker: API key auth only, per-tenant base URL (user must supply domain + key); no permanent free tier (30-day trial, then paid). Full endpoint docs gated behind login to an account.
rate_limits: 180 API requests per minute per API key

description: B2B customer support platform (Slack/email/chat threads, customers, tiers, workflows) with a GraphQL API that matches its UI.
blocker: Free access is a 7-day trial only. The pricing page does not say which paid plan includes API access. The vendor's own MCP server does not accept API keys (OAuth only).
rate_limits: not documented

description: Shared inbox and customer support platform with a knowledge base (Docs), live chat and reporting.
blocker: API needs a paid plan (Free has none). Reporting endpoints need Plus or Pro. The official MCP server is read-only.
rate_limits: 200 req/min per account (plan-dependent); writes count as 2; 12 writes per 5s burst; 429 on throttle

description: Ecommerce-focused customer support helpdesk for tickets, customers, macros and automation across email, chat, social and voice.
blocker: Buildable today with per-account API keys over Basic auth. A shared one-click OAuth2 app for end users needs Gorgias partner review and approval. The partner sandbox is a Demo account by default.
rate_limits: Leaky bucket: 40 req/20s (API key), 80 req/20s (OAuth2 apps); Enterprise uses 10s window; 429 + Retry-after

description: Customer service platform (people-centered helpdesk) unifying voice, chat, email, SMS and social conversations around customer profiles.
blocker: No self-serve signup or sandbox. API tokens exist only inside an existing customer's Gladly tenant, so we would need a customer account or partner access first.
rate_limits: 10 req/s per HTTP method; Reports API 10 req/min, 2 concurrent per org

description: Team messaging and collaboration platform with channels, DMs, files, canvases and workflows.
blocker: None for Web API toolkit. Note official MCP server restricted to Marketplace-published or internal apps; non-Marketplace apps get stricter rate limits.
rate_limits: Web API 4 tiers, per method/workspace/app, per-minute windows (Tier1 1+/min to Tier4 100+/min); Events API 30k deliveries/workspace/hr

description: Cloud communications platform with APIs for SMS/MMS/WhatsApp messaging, voice, verification, video, contact center (Flex) and more.
rate_limits: Per-product limits, no single global one: e.g. voice default 1 call/sec (queued), Proxy 30 RPS/endpoint, Video 80 read/20 write RPS, Flex Interactions 20 RPS; HTTP 429 on excess

description: Zoho Cliq is a team chat and collaboration platform with channels, bots, and a developer platform.
rate_limits: ~15-20 requests/min per authenticated user; 10-min lock on 429

description: Enterprise collaboration suite (IM, calendar, docs, base, video meetings, approvals) with an Open Platform REST API for building bots and apps.
blocker: Per-tenant admin approval of scopes. Multi-tenant OAuth distribution needs a Store app with review. Separate Feishu (China) and Lark (international) domains.
rate_limits: Per API, per app, per tenant; tiers from 10/min to 100/s (e.g. 1000/min and 50/s); HTTP 429 code 99991400; custom bots 100/min, 5/s

description: Team chat/messaging app (Slack alternative) with free unlimited users, channels, DMs and integrations.
blocker: No OAuth2 for third-party apps; auth is per-user API key or app key + user/bot tokens, so end users must generate credentials manually. API-key surface is narrow.
rate_limits: 3,000 req/min per app; 1,000 req/min per user; lower per-endpoint caps (e.g. send message 80/min per app+workspace); 429 with Retry-After

description: Chat/voice community platform; developer API lets bots and apps read/post messages, manage guilds, channels, roles, and interactions.
blocker: Minor: some OAuth scopes need Discord approval; bot-centric model (bot must be invited to each guild); official MCP at docs.discord.com/mcp is docs-search only.
rate_limits: 50 requests/sec global per bot, plus per-route limits via X-RateLimit headers
official_sdks: typescript (Embedded App SDK for Activities only; Game SDK archived; no official REST/bot client libs)

description: Cloud-based messaging app with a free HTTP Bot API (BotFather tokens) and an MTProto user-account API for sending messages, managing chats, and building bots.
rate_limits: ~30 messages/sec bulk broadcast per bot (paid broadcasts raise it); also per-chat limits

description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) lets businesses send and receive WhatsApp messages, templates, media and webhooks, and manage WABAs and phone numbers.
blocker: Multi-tenant end-user connect needs Meta App Review (Advanced access), business verification and Embedded Signup or Tech Provider setup. Single-account use with a system user token works now. Messaging is constrained by the 24-hour window and template approval.
rate_limits: 200 req/hr per app per Messaging account default (5000/hr for active accounts with a registered number); messaging throughput 80 msg/s per phone number by default (up to 1000)

description: Cloud business phone system (calls, SMS, contacts, call analytics/AI) with a public REST API and webhooks.
blocker: No self-serve developer account: credentials need an existing Aircall customer account (API key) or Tech Partner/Marketplace approval (OAuth). No official MCP server.
rate_limits: 120 requests/min per company (API key/OAuth token); exceeding blocks access for 60 seconds

description: Communications API platform for SMS, voice, messaging channels (WhatsApp etc.), verification, video, numbers and network APIs.
rate_limits: Messages API: 75 req/s per API key default, raisable; 429 on exceed

description: Google's advertising platform; API manages Google Ads accounts, campaigns, ad groups, keywords, assets and reporting.
blocker: Access-level review: Explorer is automated but low-quota; Basic/Standard need brand verification/manual review for higher volume. Developer-token sunset claim (page dated after 2026-09) should be rechecked.
rate_limits: QPS limits per customer ID and per Cloud project; exact value varies with server load; exceeded -> RESOURCE_TEMPORARILY_EXHAUSTED

description: Meta Marketing API: programmatically create and manage ad campaigns, ad sets, ads and creatives on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp, and pull performance insights.
blocker: Public multi-tenant use needs Meta App Review (ads_read/ads_management advanced access) plus Business Verification; until then only own/test ad accounts via Limited access.
rate_limits: Per ad account, score-based: read=1, write=3 pts; max 60 (dev) / 9000 (full access), 300s decay. Plus BUC hourly quotas, 100 QPS on create/edit.

description: LinkedIn Marketing/Advertising APIs to create and manage ad campaigns, report performance, manage leads and audiences.
blocker: Each developer must get Advertising API product approval from LinkedIn before the app works. Production use for many accounts needs Standard tier, which LinkedIn grants at its discretion. Only 3-legged OAuth works.
rate_limits: Per-app and per-member daily (24h, reset midnight UTC) limits, 429 on exceed; standard values not published (see Developer Portal Analytics); ads reporting 45M metric values per 5 min

description: All-in-one CRM, marketing automation, funnels, calendars, conversations and payments platform for agencies and SMBs (HighLevel / LeadConnector).
blocker: Requires a HighLevel agency or sub-account to get credentials. Public distribution needs Marketplace approval or Security Review beyond 5 agency installs. Plan or trial requirements were not verified.
rate_limits: Burst 100 requests/10s and 200,000/day, per app per resource (location or company)

description: Email marketing platform: audiences, campaigns, automations, templates, reports via Marketing API.
rate_limits: 10 simultaneous connections per user; 429 when exceeded; 120s timeout

description: Marketing automation platform for email, SMS and customer data, with a REST API for profiles, events, lists, flows, campaigns and more.
rate_limits: Per-account fixed windows, burst 1s + steady 1min; tiers XS 1/s,15/m up to XL 350/s,3500/m; per-endpoint

description: All-in-one marketing platform: sales funnels, email marketing, courses, contacts/CRM, automations, payments.
rate_limits: Rate limiting documented (X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Refill headers, 429 + Retry-After); no numeric quota published

description: Visual discovery and social platform; API v5 lets apps manage pins, boards, ads, catalogs and analytics for users and businesses.
blocker: Pinterest must approve each app for Trial access, then review it again for Standard access, which needs a demo video of the OAuth flow, before other users can connect. Trial content stays sandbox-only. Details of the official MCP server (endpoint, auth, availability) were not verified.
rate_limits: Trial 1000 req/day; Standard 100 req/s per user per app; per-category limits

description: Meta's text-based social network; Threads API lets apps publish posts, manage replies, and read insights on behalf of users.
blocker: Meta App Review plus app publishing needed before users without an app role can connect. Dev-mode testers work immediately.
rate_limits: Calls per 24h = 4800 x impressions (min 10); 250 posts, 1,000 replies, 100 deletions per rolling 24h

description: Twilio SendGrid: cloud email delivery platform (transactional and marketing email) with v3 REST API and SMTP relay.
blocker: No permanent free tier: only a 60-day trial; users need paid plan long-term. API key auth only, no OAuth.
rate_limits: Per-endpoint fixed requests per refresh period; HTTP 429 when exceeded; X-RateLimit-* headers (e.g. Email Activity API 6 req/min per changelog)

description: Ecommerce platform for merchants to build online stores, sell products, manage orders, inventory, customers and payments.
blocker: Per-store OAuth app install; public distribution needs App Store review. Official MCP is dev-docs/schema focused, not store operations.
rate_limits: GraphQL Admin: cost-based leaky bucket per app+store; restore 100 pts/s Standard, 200 Advanced, 1000 Plus, 2000 Enterprise; max single query cost 1,000.

description: Open-source WordPress ecommerce plugin; REST API exposes store data (orders, products, customers, coupons, etc.) per self-hosted store.
blocker: No OAuth2. Users must supply store URL plus consumer key/secret. Store must serve HTTPS for Basic auth. The official MCP is in developer preview, needs the MCP Adapter plugin, and authenticates with Application Passwords.
rate_limits: REST API: none documented. Store API only: optional, off by default, 25 requests per 10 s (POST only).

description: SaaS ecommerce platform for merchants: catalog, orders, customers, carts, checkout, storefront and B2B, with REST and GraphQL APIs.
rate_limits: OAuth apps: quota refreshed every 30s; plan-based, e.g. 150/30s Core/Growth, 450/30s Scale; X-Rate-Limit headers

description: Enterprise ecommerce platform (B2C Commerce) with headless Shopper and Admin APIs (SCAPI) plus legacy OCAPI for storefront and back-office automation.
blocker: No self-serve credentials: SLAS and Account Manager API clients require an existing B2C Commerce tenant/instance; Salesforce docs could not be fetched to confirm any free sandbox.
rate_limits: SCAPI load shedding and rate limiting is documented. Per search snippets: SLAS about 24,000 req/min per tenant in production and 500 in non-production. Over-limit requests get HTTP 429. Overloaded systems return 503. Unverified against the page text.

description: Ecommerce platform (Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce) for storefronts, catalog, orders, customers, with REST and GraphQL APIs.
blocker: Per-merchant instance with no central OAuth2 app registry. Self-hosted auth is OAuth 1.0a/HMAC or token-based, so it needs a custom base URL plus token. SaaS uses IMS. Adobe's official MCP servers are developer/docs tools, not store-data tools. Community MCP servers exist (StackOne, CData, Cequence).
rate_limits: Only optional order-placement throttling, off by default: per-guest (IP) and per-customer request limits over 60/3600/86400s. No general REST/GraphQL limit documented.

description: Website builder and ecommerce platform; Commerce APIs expose orders, products, inventory, contacts, discounts, transactions and webhooks for merchant sites.
blocker: A public multi-tenant integration needs a Squarespace-reviewed OAuth client. The self-serve API-key path needs the paid Commerce Advanced plan and covers one site. The official MCP's Commerce tools are limited to Claude and ChatGPT.
rate_limits: 300 requests/min (5 req/s) per Commerce API; 429 with 1-min cooldown; Create Order 100/hr per site with API key

description: Ecwid (by Lightspeed) is a cloud ecommerce platform that adds an online store to any website or social channel.
rate_limits: 600 requests/min per token; HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded

description: Platform for creators to sell digital products, memberships and courses directly to customers.
rate_limits: not documented

description: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API): REST APIs for sellers and vendors to manage orders, listings, inventory, reports, feeds, FBA and more.
blocker: Public multi-tenant use needs a developer profile approved by Amazon and app review. Credentials are not instant for end users, though private apps can self-authorize. Doc pages could not be fetched this run, so claims are unverified.
rate_limits: Token bucket per operation per seller+app pair; per-operation rate/burst in API reference; standard (static) and dynamic plans; 429 on throttle

description: Creator-economy commerce platform (FanBasis, rebranded Commas) for checkout, subscriptions, invoices, customers and payments.
rate_limits: 10,000 authenticated requests/hour on checkout-sessions and customers endpoint groups; 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-* headers

description: Pay-as-you-go API platform selling SEO and business data: SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, labs, domain analytics, content analysis, and more.
rate_limits: 10000 API calls/min total, max 100 tasks per POST (live: 1 task per POST); some APIs stricter (e.g. Google Ads live 12/min)

description: All-in-one SEO platform (rank tracking, keyword research, backlinks, site audits, AI search visibility) with Data, Project, Local Marketing and SE Visible APIs.
blocker: API needs a paid subscription or purchased credits; no free self-serve API tier. Official MCP already exists.
rate_limits: Data API 10 req/s per key; Project API 5 req/s per key; trial Data API 1 req/s; HTTP 429 when exceeded

description: SEO platform for backlink, keyword, site audit, rank tracking and AI-search data, exposed via the Ahrefs API v3.
blocker: Credentials need a paid Ahrefs plan (Lite or higher; Enterprise may be needed for new apps). The OAuth route for end users needs Ahrefs Connect approval, so API key (bearer) is the practical self-managed path.
rate_limits: 60 requests/min by default; HTTP 429 when exceeded; plus API unit costs (min 50 units per billable request)

description: AI-powered web scraping platform: give a URL and prompt, get JSON/CSV; also HTML/Markdown scrape, screenshots, web search, and managed scrapers via REST API.
rate_limits: Concurrency-based: 10 concurrent requests Free, 100 Pro; 429 with Retry-After. No per-second figure.

description: Cloud platform for web scraping and automation: run Actors (serverless scrapers/tools), store data in datasets/key-value stores, and browse Actors in Apify Store.
rate_limits: 250,000 req/min global per user; 60 req/sec per resource default (some endpoints higher); 429 on exceed

description: Web data API for AI agents: search, scrape, crawl, map, extract and interact with web pages, returning clean Markdown or structured JSON.
rate_limits: Per-minute per-team limits by plan plus concurrency caps; Free: /scrape 10, /map 10, /crawl 2, /search 10, /agent 2 per min; 2 concurrent browsers; 429 on exceed

description: Web data platform: proxy networks, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Scraper APIs, scraping browser and datasets for web scraping at scale.
rate_limits: Unfunded accounts: 1,000 req/min (SERP, Web Unlocker, Proxy); Scraper API: 25 HTTP 429s per IP in 5 min triggers 1-hour IP block

description: Open-source Python CLI that hunts down social media accounts by username across 400+ sites.
blocker: No hosted API or credentials; local CLI only. Needs sandbox execution or third-party wrapper; not a standard OAuth/API-key integration.
rate_limits: not documented

description: B2B contact and company data from 30+ providers via one GTM API: prospecting, contact/phone/company enrichment, email verification, job-change checks.
blocker: Credentials are sales-gated: no self-serve key and no public pricing. Composio would need a partnership or test key before building.
rate_limits: 50 requests per 60 seconds default (Prospector, Search, Enrichment, Job Change, Email Verification); none for Account Reporter

description: GTM data enrichment and prospecting platform; Public API runs searches, routines, tables, audiences, signals, workflows.
blocker: Caveats: API is new (beta/alpha parts), table access Enterprise-only, search credit/volume limits by plan, API-key only (no OAuth for end users). Official MCP exists per docs but no dedicated setup/URL page found; mcp.clay.earth is a different product (Clay personal CRM).
rate_limits: 300 requests/min per workspace (~5/s), shared across API keys; 429 with Retry-After; some endpoints have own limits

description: Developer platform for hosting Git repositories, collaborating on code, issues/PRs, CI (Actions) and software delivery.
rate_limits: REST primary limit: 60 req/hr unauthenticated; 5,000 req/hr authenticated users (higher for apps/Enterprise); plus secondary limits; GraphQL separate point-based limit

description: Frontend cloud platform for deploying and hosting web apps, with projects, deployments, domains, env vars, edge config, and storage managed via API.
rate_limits: Per-action hard limits by plan, e.g. deployments/day Free 100, Pro 6000, Enterprise 24000; deploy hooks 60/hour/project

description: Web platform for building, deploying and scaling web apps with serverless functions, edge logic and continuous deployment.
rate_limits: 500 requests/min for most requests; deploys via API 3/min and 100/day

description: Global network platform for CDN, DNS, security, Zero Trust, and developer services (Workers, R2, etc.), managed via REST API.
rate_limits: 1,200 requests per 5 minutes per user (global)

description: Open-source Postgres backend platform: database, auth, storage, edge functions, realtime, with auto-generated REST API and a Management API.
rate_limits: Management API: 120 requests/min per user, per project or org, per endpoint; 429 when exceeded. Some analytics endpoints 30/min.

description: Graph database platform; Aura cloud API manages instances and Query API runs Cypher over HTTP.
rate_limits: Aura API: 25 req/min (Free/trial), 125 req/min (paid); billing endpoints 10 req/day per org

description: Cloud data platform (AI Data Cloud) for data warehousing, lakes, analytics, and AI workloads.
blocker: Per-account base URL and per-account OAuth security integration (admin setup); trial lapses without paid account. Otherwise self-serve.
rate_limits: not documented

description: Managed cloud database platform (MongoDB DBaaS); Admin API manages orgs, projects, clusters, users, backups, networking and more.
rate_limits: Token bucket per endpoint set and scope (org/project/user/IP); 429 RATE_LIMITED_TOKEN_BUCKET with Retry-After; limits vary per endpoint, queryable via rateLimits API, may change without notice

description: Cloud observability and security platform for monitoring infrastructure, apps, logs, and traces.
rate_limits: Limits vary per endpoint, returned in X-RateLimit-* headers; 429 when limited; event submission 250,000/min per org; metric submission not rate limited

description: Application monitoring platform for error tracking, performance monitoring and issue triage.
rate_limits: Per-endpoint requests-per-second (fixed window) plus concurrent-request limit; no default numbers; X-Sentry-Rate-Limit-* headers

description: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, databases and project/task management.
rate_limits: Per connection: 600 req/min (Business/Enterprise), 180 req/min (other plans); plus shared per-workspace limit; HTTP 429 + Retry-After

description: Low-code cloud database/spreadsheet hybrid platform for building apps, workflows and automations on structured data.
rate_limits: 5 req/s per base; 50 req/s per user/service account across PATs; 429 then wait 30s

description: Work-management tool for issues, projects, cycles and initiatives, with a public GraphQL API, webhooks, OAuth apps and a hosted MCP server.
rate_limits: API key 2,500 req/hr per user; OAuth app 5,000 req/hr; complexity cap 10,000 pts/query (3M/hr API key); 429 + Retry-After

description: Atlassian's issue and project tracking tool for software and business teams.
rate_limits: Points-based quota model plus per-second burst limit per endpoint (defaults ~100 rps GET/POST, 50 PUT/DELETE); 429 on excess

description: Work management platform for teams to organize tasks, projects, and workflows.
rate_limits: 150 req/min free domain, 1,500 req/min paid, per token; search 60/min; 50 concurrent GET, 15 concurrent writes; 429 + Retry-After

description: Work management platform for boards, projects, CRM and workflows, with a GraphQL API.
rate_limits: Complexity 5M pts/min (app token), 10M/min (personal token); daily calls 200 Free to 25,000 Enterprise; 1,000-5,000 queries/min by plan

description: Work management platform for tasks, docs, goals, time tracking and team collaboration.
rate_limits: 100 req/min per token (Free Forever, Unlimited, Business); 1,000 Business Plus; 10,000 Enterprise; HTTP 429 on exceed

description: Collaborative doc platform (now Superhuman Docs) combining docs, tables, and automations, with a public REST API and Packs.
blocker: No documented OAuth2 for the REST API, so users must supply personal API tokens. The auth section of the docs was not fully readable, so OAuth absence is not fully confirmed.
rate_limits: Reads 100 req/6s; writes 10 req/6s; doc content writes 5 req/10s; listing docs 4 req/6s; HTTP 429 on exceed

description: Work management and collaboration platform with spreadsheet-style sheets, reports, dashboards, and automation.
blocker: API and MCP need a paid Business, Enterprise or AWM plan. The trial cannot generate tokens, so testing needs a paid account.
rate_limits: 300 requests/min per API token; 30/min for file attachment posts and cell history (10x multiplier); HTTP 429 on exceed

description: Time tracking, invoicing and expense/project reporting SaaS.
rate_limits: 100 requests per 15 seconds (general); Reports API 100 per 15 minutes; HTTP 429 + Retry-After

description: Online payments platform: payments, billing, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, Connect marketplaces, and more, exposed via API.
rate_limits: 100 req/s live mode, 25 req/s sandbox, per Stripe account; many endpoints 25 req/s

description: Financial data API: link bank accounts and fetch auth, balances, transactions, identity, investments, liabilities, income, and payments.
blocker: The flow needs Plaid Link (a client-side UI) to get an access_token per end user, so a pure agent flow is awkward. Production access needs approval, and some products are plan-gated. The official MCP server is Dashboard diagnostics only, not data access, and needs Production approval.
rate_limits: Per-endpoint limits per Item and per client, e.g. /transactions/sync 50/min per Item, 2,500/min per client; /accounts/balance/get 5/min per Item; fixed windows

description: Global crypto exchange; public APIs for spot/futures/margin trading, market data, wallet, earn and more.
blocker: Per-user key creation needs deposit plus identity verification. HMAC deprecated, so asymmetric signing (Ed25519/RSA) should be supported. Not OAuth, so users must paste keys.
rate_limits: Per-IP request weight limit (about 6000/min per search snippet), plus separate order-count limits; 429 then 418 IP ban

description: Paygent Connect appears to be a payment gateway white-labeled on NMI, which handles card and ACH payments, a customer vault, recurring billing and invoicing. I could not confirm this from a Paygent page.
blocker: No Paygent-specific developer docs found, so the NMI link is unverified. Live keys need a merchant account, and users must supply their own gateway host and key. Only an unofficial, read-only community MCP exists, built for NMI-family gateways.
rate_limits: Rate limits exist but no numeric limit; Payment API returns response_code 301 'Rate limit exceeded', system-wide HTTP 429

description: FINTRAC-registered forensic FX audit engine that detects hidden bank spreads vs mid-market rates on currency transactions, via REST API, webhooks and MCP server.
blocker: Narrow API (about 3-6 endpoints), tiny free quota, and inconsistent docs (endpoints, prices, MCP URL differ across pages). Self-serve keys exist, so buildable but low value.
rate_limits: not documented

description: Intuit QuickBooks Online: cloud accounting software; developer platform exposes Accounting and Payments APIs for third-party apps.
blocker: Production use against other users' live companies needs Intuit app review/assessment; refresh tokens rotate; redirect URIs must be https in production.
rate_limits: 500 requests/min per realm ID (sandbox and production); batch endpoint lower (40/min per realm+app per one page; 120/min per another); ~10 concurrent requests per realm

description: Cloud accounting software for small businesses; its API exposes accounting, payroll, and related data.
blocker: The free Starter tier allows only 5 connections. Scaling needs a paid plan, and Plus or above needs App Certification. Custom Connections are paid.
rate_limits: 60 calls/min and 5,000/day per tenant, 5 concurrent, 10,000/min per app; HTTP 429 on exceed

description: Corporate card, spend management and finance platform for businesses (cards, expenses, payments, budgets, team management).
blocker: No self-serve developer account or sandbox. Credentials exist only inside a Brex customer account, and OAuth for a multi-tenant app needs a client ID and secret from Brex developer support.
rate_limits: 1,000 requests per 60 seconds per Client ID and Brex account; HTTP 429 when exceeded

description: Corporate card, spend management, bill pay and accounting automation platform for businesses.
blocker: No public signup: credentials require a Ramp customer account with admin access (or sandbox request). Multi-tenant OAuth apps for other businesses need Ramp partner approval; some scopes plan- or partner-gated. Also, vendor-official MCP exists.
rate_limits: 200 requests / 10 s per source IP; token endpoint 100 POST / 10 s per IP; 429 and 60 s block

description: Private capital market data platform (companies, deals, investors, funds) with a contract-based REST API.
blocker: No self-serve credentials. API needs a paid PitchBook contract plus an account-manager-issued key, so a developer cannot get working credentials without a sales relationship.
rate_limits: not documented

description: Google's AI research notebook tool (NotebookLM Enterprise, renamed Gemini Notebook Enterprise) that generates insights and summaries from user documents.
blocker: Enterprise-only: the API needs a paid NotebookLM Enterprise subscription (minimum 15 licenses) or a 14-day trial, plus a Google Cloud project. It is v1alpha with a narrow surface. The consumer product has no public API. The community MCP servers use undocumented internal APIs and browser cookies, and Google publishes no MCP server.
rate_limits: No API QPS documented; product usage limits only: 500 queries/user/day, 500 notebooks/user, 300 sources/notebook

description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings and conversations.
blocker: REST API is Enterprise-only (Bearer key); no free self-serve creds. Only the read-only OAuth MCP server (search, fetch, get_user_info) is open to standard accounts, and its OAuth client registration (DCR/CIMD) needs handling.
rate_limits: Public API: ~10 req/s for Enterprise users, 429 when exceeded (from search summary of help article, not read directly; MCP limits not documented)

description: AI meeting recorder that records, transcribes and summarizes video calls (Zoom, Meet, Teams) and exposes the meeting data via API.
rate_limits: 60 calls / 60 s per account; heavy requests (summary/transcript) 30 / 60 s (may drop to 5); 429 + Retry-After

description: AI-powered scientific research search engine (consensus.app) that finds, summarizes and cites peer-reviewed papers, with a Consensus Meter.
blocker: REST API key appears tied to an organization subscription (paid/enterprise), not free self-serve. OAuth exists only via the MCP server, so an OAuth-based toolkit would have to go through MCP (free tier available, dynamic client registration). Narrow read-only surface.
rate_limits: REST limits per org plan (numbers on docs/pricing, not seen); 429 + Retry-After on exceed; MCP per-plan table (Free: 1 QPS per user)

description: Agentic document platform: parse, extract, split, classify and edit documents (PDFs, images, Office files) via API.
rate_limits: 1,000 req/s per API key on all endpoints (429 over limit); GET /job/{id} 300 req/s; plus per-plan page-concurrency caps

description: Autonomous AI software engineer (Cognition) with a v3 REST API to manage sessions, knowledge, playbooks and secrets, plus an official hosted MCP server.
blocker: Free-tier API access is unconfirmed, as the pricing table did not render. Auth is a static key or PAT only, with no OAuth for end users. Enterprise endpoints need an enterprise account.
rate_limits: not documented

description: AI image and video generation platform; exposes a pay-as-you-go async REST API over 50+ generative models, plus an MCP server and CLI.
blocker: API requires prepaid funding ($5 minimum), with no free tier. Auth is a key ID + secret pair, so OAuth2 is not offered for the REST API. The OAuth-style MCP/CLI path needs a paid subscription. The API surface is generation-only.
rate_limits: Concurrency-based limit per account/model; queue limit is a multiple of concurrency; no default numbers published, see dashboard

description: Command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG/PNG/PDF files; also has a Node.js API.
blocker: No hosted API. It is a local CLI that needs Node and Chromium, so a toolkit would need a sandboxed runtime to render. Community MCP servers exist, but there is no official one.
rate_limits: not documented

description: TranscriptAPI: REST API and hosted MCP server to fetch YouTube video transcripts, search videos, and browse channels and playlists.
rate_limits: 200 requests/min per key (homepage: 200 RPM monthly, 300 RPM annual); 429 with Retry-After

description: AI meeting recorder/notes platform; public API reads and manages recordings, transcripts, highlights, uploads, and webhooks.
blocker: Server-side OAuth client credentials are requested manually from Grain; the workspace scope needs Grain verification; the workspace token needs a Business/Enterprise plan. PAT is self-serve on any plan.
rate_limits: 300 requests/min per token; 429 beyond; rate limit headers returned
